securite.title: Safety & Tips
securite.subtitle: Buy and sell with confidence
securite.intro: Kivoo does everything it can to keep your experience safe. Follow these tips to avoid scams and transact with peace of mind across Côte d'Ivoire.
securite.rule1_desc: Always choose a busy location: shopping centre, police station, market. Avoid unknown homes, especially for first transactions.
securite.rule2_desc: Never pay before physically seeing and inspecting the item. No serious seller will ask for a bank transfer, Orange Money or Wave deposit before handing over the goods.
securite.rule3_desc: Prefer sellers with the Confirmed ✅ badge (KYC verified identity). Check their previous listings and rating. Be wary of recently created profiles.
securite.rule4_desc: Test the product on the spot before any payment. For electronics, check the IMEI. For vehicles, request a test drive and the original documents.
securite.rule5_desc: If you suspect a scam, use the Report button on the listing. Our moderation team reviews every report within 24h and blocks fraudulent accounts.
securite.rule6_desc: Communicate via Kivoo messaging rather than SMS. This allows us to detect and block scam attempts and keeps a record of your exchanges.
securite.scam1: The price is unusually low compared to the market
securite.scam2: The seller refuses to meet in person
securite.scam3: You are asked to pay before seeing the item
securite.scam4: The seller claims to be abroad or travelling
securite.scam5: You are sent a suspicious external link
securite.scam6: The seller asks for your banking information
securite.scam7: The photos appear to be images found on the internet
securite.victim_desc: Report the listing directly from the platform or contact us immediately. We will block the account and cooperate with the authorities if necessary.

cgu.intro: By using Kivoo, you agree to these terms in their entirety. Please read them carefully.
cgu.s1_b1_text: Kivoo is a purely technical host and intermediary connecting buyers and sellers, whether individuals or professionals. The platform takes no part in any commercial transaction and is not a party to any contracts concluded between users.
cgu.s1_b2_text: Listings are published under the sole responsibility of their authors. Kivoo does not systematically verify the accuracy, legality or availability of the goods and services offered, except within the scope of its moderation policy.
cgu.s2_b1_text: The platform publisher is in no way responsible for physical, financial or legal disputes that may arise between buyers and sellers. Any transaction is carried out under the sole responsibility of the parties involved.
cgu.s2_b2_text: Kivoo's liability cannot be engaged in the event of service interruption, data loss or indirect damages resulting from use of the platform, to the extent permitted by applicable Ivorian law.
cgu.s3_b1_text: The processing of your personal data is carried out in accordance with Ivorian law n°2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on the protection of personal data, under the authority of the Telecommunications/ICT Regulatory Authority of Côte d'Ivoire (ARTCI).
cgu.s3_b2_title: Data collected and proof of consent
cgu.s3_b2_text: Upon registration, we collect your email address and phone number. For legal proof purposes, your consent to these Terms is timestamped with your IP address and User-Agent in accordance with law n°2013-450. This data is never sold to third parties.
cgu.s3_b3_text: You have the right to access, correct and delete your personal data. To exercise these rights: dpo@kivoo.ci
cgu.s4_b1_text: Strictly prohibited on Kivoo: firearms, ammunition and bladed weapons; narcotics and psychotropic substances; counterfeits infringing intellectual property rights; land without clear title deeds (ACD, registered title); pornographic content or content involving minors; any content inciting hatred or discrimination.
cgu.s4_b2_text: Any violation results in immediate removal of the listing, permanent account ban, and may be reported to the competent Ivorian authorities (Criminal Investigation Police, PLCC).
cgu.consent_text: By creating your account, you confirm that you have read and accepted these Terms. Your consent is recorded with a timestamp and IP address, in accordance with law n°2013-450.
